facts.claim: Carnival Spirit (Carnival Cruise Line): Entered service 2001; 88,500 GT; 2130 guests (lower berth / double occupancy); 294 m length; Spirit class.
Get ready for an unforgettable cruise adventure full of fun and activities onboard Carnival Spirit. Book your cruise vacation today!

Carnival Spirit is more than a ship, but an unforgettable vacation experience you’ll be reliving for a long time. Whether you’re after something that’s action-packed or just want to relax and unwind, this ship has what you’re looking for. (Our suggestion: choose both!)
Carnival Spirit is a Spirit-class cruise ship operated by Carnival Cruise Line, a subsidiary of Carnival Corporation & plc.
Built in Helsinki by Kværner Masa-Yards, she was the first Spirit-class cruise ship to join Carnival's fleet after she was delivered in 2001.

catalogSpecs.description: Completed a month-long dry dock in March 2025, introducing various upgrades and enhancements to public spaces and amenities.
